summary: Jurassic World Evolution entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Jurassic World Evolution
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release with DLC/park state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with exact DLC/save/mod state documented

primary.version: Current PC release with DLC state documented
primary.why: The PC route is the best capture path for park management, DLC campaigns, dinosaur roster, and graphics settings. Switch Complete Edition and sequels are separate routes and should not replace the original PC entry.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release with intended DLC installed. Record build, DLC, island/campaign/challenge/sandbox mode, dinosaur roster, mods, graphics settings, save/park state, and whether Switch Complete Edition or sequels were compared.

secondary.why: PC remains the stronger capture and settings route.

all_releases.fidelity: Main release family, with PC preferred for capture.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: DLC ownership and platform route determine campaign/dinosaur/content scope.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Jurassic World Evolution 2 or 3.
